name: devops-team
description: A three-expert engineering efficiency team: tech lead, QA expert and SRE expert working in parallel on iteration reports, release checklists and incident briefs.

displayDescription.en: A three-expert team for engineering teams: the tech lead owns designs and releases, the QA expert guards quality gates, and the SRE expert leads incident investigation and postmortems. Every conclusion is traceable to commits, tickets or timelines; data gaps are stated, never hidden.
displayDescription.zh: 研发效能三人专家团：技术负责人统筹方案与上线，测试专家把守质量门禁，SRE 专家主导线上排查与复盘。
